# WinChat

> A retrieval-augmented assistant that answers University of Windsor questions using only
> the university's own published FAQ articles, with a link to the source article behind
> every claim. It declines to answer when the corpus does not cover a question rather than
> guessing.

WinChat is not affiliated with or operated by the University of Windsor. It is an
independent project built on the university's public FAQ service at https://ask.uwindsor.ca.
For anything official, use the university's own pages.

## What it covers

556 published FAQ articles from ask.uwindsor.ca, spanning admissions, tuition and fees,
OSAP and financial aid, UWinsite Student, UWin accounts, the UwinCARD, course registration,
transcripts, residence, co-op, campus buildings and student services.

The complete list of source articles, each linking to the university's own page:
- [All sources](/sources): every article WinChat can answer from

## How it answers

- Hybrid retrieval: vector similarity over pgvector plus Postgres full-text search, fused
  with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
- Answers cite their sources inline; each citation links to the original article.
- Below a calibrated similarity threshold it declines to answer instead of guessing.
- Source content belongs to the University of Windsor. WinChat quotes and links; it does
  not republish the corpus.
